headline: Philippines' Pag-IBIG Fund Finances ₱127.4 Billion in Housing Loans
summary: Pag-IBIG Fund financed 78,410 home acquisitions valued at ₱127.44 billion during the first 10 months of 2026, marking a 15% increase driven by subsidized socialized housing programs.
why: Pag-IBIG Fund is a state-owned home development mutual fund that dominates subsidized residential mortgage financing in the Philippines.
